summary: Iteration 30 - Backend video pipeline testing (Raspberry Pi upload + admin viewing + cleanup). 15/16 backend tests pass. Full pipeline (upload -> persist reference on access_log -> list -> download via Bearer header -> manual cleanup -> cron function do_cleanup_old_videos) works correctly. One legitimate bug found: the query-parameter token fallback for GET /api/access/video/{video_id} is broken because auth.security = HTTPBearer() with default auto_error=True intercepts requests without an Authorization header before the endpoint can inspect the ?token= query param.

minor.issue: Query-parameter ?token= authentication fallback does not work. The endpoint signature declares `credentials: Optional[HTTPAuthorizationCredentials] = Depends(security)` and `token: Optional[str] = None`, but auth.py defines `security = HTTPBearer()` (auto_error defaults to True). Result: any request without an `Authorization: Bearer ...` header is rejected with 403 by HTTPBearer before the endpoint runs. This breaks HTML5 <video src="/api/access/video/xxx?token=jwt"> playback where the browser cannot inject an Authorization header. Fix: change auth.py to `security = HTTPBearer(auto_error=False)` (this endpoint already tolerates Optional creds) or use a route-specific dependency.

action_items: Change `security = HTTPBearer()` to `security = HTTPBearer(auto_error=False)` in /app/backend/auth.py so the video endpoint's query-param token fallback works for <video> tags. Verify all other endpoints that depend on `security` still receive 401 via decode_jwt_token(None)-> None -> raise 401 (a quick audit of routes using `security` is needed since some assume creds is never None).
OPTIONAL: Consider migrating from @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') to FastAPI lifespan handlers (deprecation warnings during test run).

10MB size limit is checked AFTER reading the whole upload into memory (`await video.read()` then `len(content) > 10MB`). For 11MB it still works, but for very large uploads this loads entire body first. Consider streaming/size check via Content-Length header for robustness. Not blocking.

rca_of_query_token_bug: Root cause: /app/backend/auth.py line 15 => `security = HTTPBearer()`. In FastAPI/starlette, HTTPBearer with auto_error=True (default) responds 403 'Not authenticated' immediately when the Authorization header is missing or malformed, BEFORE any endpoint code runs. Consequently, video_routes.py:61 `credentials: Optional[HTTPAuthorizationCredentials] = Depends(security)` never receives None; the request is rejected. Reproduction: `curl 'https://<host>/api/access/video/<video_id>?token=<valid_jwt>'` -> 403. With Authorization header: -> 200. Mitigation: set `security = HTTPBearer(auto_error=False)` and add explicit None handling in every endpoint that already treats creds as required (they call `credentials.credentials` unconditionally). Alternative surgical fix: define a dedicated `optional_security = HTTPBearer(auto_error=False)` for the video route only, leaving other routes unchanged.
